# Bundled third-party libraries

These locally served browser assets are built from the exact versions in the repository `package.json` and `package-lock.json`.

- Supabase JS 2.118.0 — Apache-2.0
- Blockly 12.3.1 — Apache-2.0
- CodeMirror 6.0.1 and `@codemirror/lang-python` 6.2.1 — MIT
- `@codemirror/theme-one-dark` 6.1.2 — MIT
- Tailwind CSS and CLI 4.3.0 — MIT

The corresponding license texts are available in the installed npm packages and their published source distributions.
